chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us via a continuous chain to the Truthful, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), that he said:

The minimum that suffices from supplication after the obligatory [prayer] is that he says: 'O Allah, bestow blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O Allah, I ask You from every good of which You have knowledge, and I seek refuge in You from every evil of which You have knowledge. O Allah, I ask You for Your well-being in all my affairs, and I seek refuge in You from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.'
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum recommended supplication to recite after obligatory prayers in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a concise yet comprehensive 'minimum' supplication for post-obligatory prayer, emphasizing the centrality of Salawat. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on integrating universal divine attributes—knowing all good and evil—with specific personal well-being (*'afiyah*) and protection from both worldly and otherworldly consequences.

en.basel-kadem: 45.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed ibn Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, from Muhammed bin Ali, from Muhammed bin Aslam, from Hasan ibn Muhammed al-Hashimi, from Umar bin Udhayna, from Aban bin Abi ‘Ayyash, from Sulaim bin Qais al-Hilali, from the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, that he said:

I said to him: What is the least by which a man is aberrant? He said: That he does not know whom Allah has ordered to obey, obliged his Divine Authority and made His Proof on His earth and His Observer upon His creation. I said: Then who are they, O Commander of the Believers? He said: Those whom Allah set parallel to Himself and His Prophet, to which He said: «O you who have believed, obey Allah, and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you.» [4:59] He said: Then I kissed his head and said: You have clarified to me, relieved me and removed every doubt that was in my heart.
